entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [DecidableEq U] [Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (y : U → ℝ) (g : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Allocation U T), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.totalSS y = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.treatmentSS y g + StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.residualSS y g
entries.source:
/-- **The one-way analysis of variance identity** (`Mead §2.2`, `Mead §6.2`):
`SS_Total = SS_Treatment + SS_Residual`. -/
theorem anova_decomposition (y : U → ℝ) (g : Allocation U T) :
    totalSS y = treatmentSS y g + residualSS y g := by
  classical
  have key : ∑ i, (y i - armMean y (g i) g) * (armMean y (g i) g - populationMean y)
      = 0 := by
    have hfib : ∑ t, ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => g i = t),
        ((y i - armMean y (g i) g) * (armMean y (g i) g - populationMean y))
        = ∑ i, (y i - armMean y (g i) g) * (armMean y (g i) g - populationMean y) :=
      Finset.sum_fiberwise _ _ _
    rw [← hfib]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t _ => ?_
    have hfe : Finset.univ.filter (fun i => g i = t) = arm t g := rfl
    rw [hfe]
    have hcongr : ∀ i ∈ arm t g,
        (y i - armMean y (g i) g) * (armMean y (g i) g - populationMean y)
        = (y i - armMean y t g) * (armMean y t g - populationMean y) := by
      intro i hi
      rw [mem_arm_iff.mp hi]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcongr, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_sub_armMean_eq_zero,
      zero_mul]
  unfold totalSS treatmentSS residualSS
  calc ∑ i, (y i - populationMean y) ^ 2
      = ∑ i, ((armMean y (g i) g - populationMean y) ^ 2
          + (y i - armMean y (g i) g) ^ 2
          + 2 * ((y i - armMean y (g i) g) * (armMean y (g i) g - populationMean y))) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
    _ = ∑ i, (armMean y (g i) g - populationMean y) ^ 2
          + ∑ i, (y i - armMean y (g i) g) ^ 2
          + 2 * ∑ i, (y i - armMean y (g i) g) * (armMean y (g i) g - populationMean y) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ i, (armMean y (g i) g - populationMean y) ^ 2
          + ∑ i, (y i - armMean y (g i) g) ^ 2 := by
        rw [key, mul_zero, add_zero]
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.totalSS y = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.treatmentSS y g + StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.residualSS y g
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.anova_decomposition
entries.doc:
**The one-way analysis of variance identity** (`Mead §2.2`, `Mead §6.2`):
`SS_Total = SS_Treatment + SS_Residual`.

entries.statement: {U : Type u_1} → {T : Type u_2} → [Fintype U] → [DecidableEq T] → T → StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Allocation U T → Finset U
entries.source:
/-- The **treatment arm** of `t` under allocation `a`: the units assigned to `t`
(`Mead §6.2`, the group of units receiving one treatment). -/
def arm (t : T) (a : Allocation U T) : Finset U :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun i => a i = t
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.arm
entries.doc:
The **treatment arm** of `t` under allocation `a`: the units assigned to `t`
(`Mead §6.2`, the group of units receiving one treatment).

entries.statement: {U : Type u_1} → {T : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq T] → T → U → StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Allocation U T → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **assignment indicator** `1{a(i) = t}` as a real number — Mead's `δ`
indicator random variable of the randomization theory (`Mead §9.4`), viewed as a
statistic of the allocation. -/
def armIndicator (t : T) (i : U) (a : Allocation U T) : ℝ :=
  if a i = t then 1 else 0
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator
entries.doc:
The **assignment indicator** `1{a(i) = t}` as a real number — Mead's `δ`
indicator random variable of the randomization theory (`Mead §9.4`), viewed as a
statistic of the allocation.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] [Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (t : T) (i : U) (a : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Allocation U T), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t i a = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionIndicator i (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.arm t a)
entries.source:
/-- The assignment indicator is the inclusion indicator of the arm. -/
theorem armIndicator_eq_inclusionIndicator (t : T) (i : U) (a : Allocation U T) :
    armIndicator t i a = inclusionIndicator i (arm t a) := by
  rw [armIndicator, inclusionIndicator]
  simp only [mem_arm_iff]

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [Fintype U] [DecidableEq U] [Fintype T] [inst : DecidableEq T] {t s : T}, t ≠ s → ∀ (i : U) (a : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Allocation U T), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t i a * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator s i a = 0
entries.source:
/-- Arms are mutually exclusive: indicators of distinct treatments at the same unit
have vanishing product (`Mead §9.4`, the joint properties of the `δ` indicators). -/
theorem armIndicator_mul_armIndicator_of_ne {t s : T}
    -- LEAN-ONLY: distinct treatments; the case `t = s` is the idempotency below
    (hts : t ≠ s) (i : U) (a : Allocation U T) :
    armIndicator t i a * armIndicator s i a = 0 := by
  unfold armIndicator
  rcases eq_or_ne (a i) t with h | h
  · rw [if_neg fun hs => hts (h.symm.trans hs), mul_zero]
  · rw [if_neg h, zero_mul]
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t i a * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator s i a = 0
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator_mul_armIndicator_of_ne
entries.doc:
Arms are mutually exclusive: indicators of distinct treatments at the same unit
have vanishing product (`Mead §9.4`, the joint properties of the `δ` indicators).

/-- Assignment indicators are idempotent (`0/1`-valued). -/
theorem armIndicator_mul_self (t : T) (i : U) (a : Allocation U T) :
    armIndicator t i a * armIndicator t i a = armIndicator t i a := by
  unfold armIndicator
  split <;> ring

/-- **Blocked randomization**: independent completely randomised designs within the
blocks of `bl`, with per-block replications `r b` (`Mead §2.5`, `Mead §9.2`). -/
noncomputable def blockedRandomization (bl : U → B) (r : B → T → ℕ)
    -- USER-INPUT: within each block the replications exhaust the block; Mead §2.5
    (hr : ∀ b, ∑ t, r b t = Fintype.card (Stratum bl b)) :
    PMF (∀ b, Allocation (Stratum bl b) T) :=
  productDesign fun b => completeRandomization (r b) (hr b)

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] [inst_4 : Fintype B] [inst_5 : DecidableEq B] (bl : U → B) (r : B → T → ℕ) (hr : ∀ (b : B), ∑ t, r b t = Fintype.card (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Stratum bl b)) {i j : U}, bl i ≠ bl j → ∀ (t s : T), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.blockedRandomization bl r hr) (fun ω => StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t i (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.glueAllocation bl ω)) fun ω => StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator s j (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.glueAllocation bl ω)) = 0

/-- **Independence across blocks**: assignment indicators of units in different
blocks are uncorrelated (`Mead §9.4`, independence of the randomisation in different
blocks). -/
theorem blocked_cov_armIndicator_of_ne_block (bl : U → B) (r : B → T → ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ b, ∑ t, r b t = Fintype.card (Stratum bl b)) {i j : U}
    -- LEAN-ONLY: the two units lie in distinct blocks; within-block covariances are
    -- those of the completely randomised design
    (hij : bl i ≠ bl j) (t s : T) :
    pmfCov (blockedRandomization bl r hr)
        (fun ω => armIndicator t i (glueAllocation bl ω))
        (fun ω => armIndicator s j (glueAllocation bl ω)) = 0 := by
  classical
  exact pmfCov_productDesign_of_ne (fun b => completeRandomization (r b) (hr b)) hij
    (armIndicator t (⟨i, rfl⟩ : Stratum bl (bl i)))
    (armIndicator s (⟨j, rfl⟩ : Stratum bl (bl j)))

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] [inst_4 : Fintype B] [inst_5 : DecidableEq B] (bl : U → B) (r : B → T → ℕ) (hr : ∀ (b : B), ∑ t, r b t = Fintype.card (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Stratum bl b)) (i : U) (t : T), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.blockedRandomization bl r hr) fun ω => StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t i (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.glueAllocation bl ω)) = ↑(r (bl i) t) / ↑(Fintype.card (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Stratum bl (bl i)))
entries.source:
/-- **Marginal assignment probability under blocked randomization**: unit `i` receives
treatment `t` with its within-block frequency `r_{bl i}(t) / N_{bl i}`
(`Mead §9.4`, `P(δᵏᵢⱼ = 1) = 1/t` in the equireplicate case). -/
theorem blocked_expect_armIndicator (bl : U → B) (r : B → T → ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ b, ∑ t, r b t = Fintype.card (Stratum bl b)) (i : U) (t : T) :
    pmfExpect (blockedRandomization bl r hr)
        (fun ω => armIndicator t i (glueAllocation bl ω))
      = (r (bl i) t : ℝ) / (Fintype.card (Stratum bl (bl i)) : ℝ) := by
  classical
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (expect_armIndicator (r (bl i)) (hr (bl i)) (⟨i, rfl⟩ : Stratum bl (bl i)) t)
  exact pmfExpect_productDesign_comp (fun b => completeRandomization (r b) (hr b))
    (bl i) (armIndicator t (⟨i, rfl⟩ : Stratum bl (bl i)))

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] (S T : Finset ι) (x : ι → Bool), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character S x * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character T x = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character (symmDiff S T) x
entries.source:
/-- **Multiplicativity**: `χ_S · χ_T = χ_{S Δ T}` — Mead's product rule for effect
rows (`Mead §13.1`; the group law behind confounding, `Mead §16.2`). -/
theorem character_mul (S T : Finset ι) (x : ι → Bool) :
    character S x * character T x = character (symmDiff S T) x := by
  classical
  have hchi : character (symmDiff S T) x
      = (∏ j ∈ S \ T, levelSign (x j)) * ∏ j ∈ T \ S, levelSign (x j) := by
    have hdd : Disjoint (S \ T) (T \ S) := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro a ha hb
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hb).2 (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ha).1
    unfold character
    rw [symmDiff_def, Finset.sup_eq_union, Finset.prod_union hdd]
  have hd : Disjoint (S \ T) (S ∩ T) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro a ha hb
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ha).2 (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).2
  have hd' : Disjoint (T \ S) (T ∩ S) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro a ha hb
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp ha).2 (Finset.mem_inter.mp hb).2
  have hS : (∏ j ∈ S, levelSign (x j))
      = (∏ j ∈ S \ T, levelSign (x j)) * ∏ j ∈ S ∩ T, levelSign (x j) := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_union hd, Finset.sdiff_union_inter]
  have hT : (∏ j ∈ T, levelSign (x j))
      = (∏ j ∈ T \ S, levelSign (x j)) * ∏ j ∈ S ∩ T, levelSign (x j) := by
    rw [Finset.inter_comm, ← Finset.prod_union hd', Finset.sdiff_union_inter]
  have hsq : (∏ j ∈ S ∩ T, levelSign (x j)) * ∏ j ∈ S ∩ T, levelSign (x j) = 1 := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_one fun j _ => levelSign_mul_self (x j)
  rw [hchi]
  unfold character
  rw [hS, hT]
  calc ((∏ j ∈ S \ T, levelSign (x j)) * ∏ j ∈ S ∩ T, levelSign (x j))
        * ((∏ j ∈ T \ S, levelSign (x j)) * ∏ j ∈ S ∩ T, levelSign (x j))
      = ((∏ j ∈ S \ T, levelSign (x j)) * ∏ j ∈ T \ S, levelSign (x j))
        * ((∏ j ∈ S ∩ T, levelSign (x j)) * ∏ j ∈ S ∩ T, levelSign (x j)) := by ring
    _ = (∏ j ∈ S \ T, levelSign (x j)) * ∏ j ∈ T \ S, levelSign (x j) := by
        rw [hsq, mul_one]
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character S x * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character T x = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character (symmDiff S T) x
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character_mul
entries.doc:
**Multiplicativity**: `χ_S · χ_T = χ_{S Δ T}` — Mead's product rule for effect
rows (`Mead §13.1`; the group law behind confounding, `Mead §16.2`).

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (x : ι → Bool), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character S x * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character S x = 1

/-- Characters square to one pointwise. -/
theorem character_mul_self (S : Finset ι) (x : ι → Bool) :
    character S x * character S x = 1 := by
  unfold character
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_one fun j _ => levelSign_mul_self (x j)

entries.source:
/-- The **completely randomised design** with replication pattern `r`: the uniform
distribution on the valid allocations (`Mead §6.2`, `Mead §9.2`). -/
noncomputable def completeRandomization (r : T → ℕ)
    (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) : RandomizationDesign U T :=
  PMF.uniformOfFinset (validAllocations r) (validAllocations_nonempty r hr)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization
entries.doc:
The **completely randomised design** with replication pattern `r`: the uniform
distribution on the valid allocations (`Mead §6.2`, `Mead §9.2`).

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (r : T → ℕ) (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) (t : T), PMF.map (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.arm t) (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization r hr) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.simpleRandomSampling (r t) (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.replication_le_card r hr t)
entries.source:
/-- **Arms of a completely randomised design are simple random samples**: the
pushforward of the design under `a ↦ arm t a` is SRSWOR of size `r t`
(`Mead §9.2`/`§9.6`). -/
theorem completeRandomization_map_arm (r : T → ℕ)
    (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) (t : T) :
    (completeRandomization r hr).map (arm t)
      = simpleRandomSampling (r t) (replication_le_card r hr t) := by
  classical
  have hoff : ∀ X ∉ Finset.powersetCard (r t) (Finset.univ : Finset U),
      ((completeRandomization r hr).map (arm t)) X = 0 := by
    intro X hX
    rw [PMF.apply_eq_zero_iff]
    intro hmem
    rw [PMF.support_map] at hmem
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hmem
    have hcard := (mem_support_completeRandomization.mp ha) t
    exact hX (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hcard⟩)
  have hconst : ∀ X₁ ∈ Finset.powersetCard (r t) (Finset.univ : Finset U),
      ∀ X₂ ∈ Finset.powersetCard (r t) (Finset.univ : Finset U),
      ((completeRandomization r hr).map (arm t)) X₁
        = ((completeRandomization r hr).map (arm t)) X₂ := by
    intro X₁ h₁ X₂ h₂
    have hcards : X₁.card = X₂.card := by
      rw [(Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp h₁).2, (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp h₂).2]
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_image_eq hcards
    rw [map_arm_apply, map_arm_apply, ← hσ, card_filter_arm_image]
  exact eq_uniformOfFinset_of_constant _ _
    (samplesOfCard_nonempty (replication_le_card r hr t)) hoff hconst
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization_map_arm
entries.doc:
**Arms of a completely randomised design are simple random samples**: the
pushforward of the design under `a ↦ arm t a` is SRSWOR of size `r t`
(`Mead §9.2`/`§9.6`).

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (r : T → ℕ) (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) (σ : Equiv.Perm U), PMF.map (fun a i => a (σ i)) (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization r hr) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization r hr
entries.source:
/-- **Randomisation symmetry**: the completely randomised design is invariant under
relabelling the units by any permutation (`Mead §9.2`: every unit is treated
symmetrically by the random allocation). -/
theorem completeRandomization_map_precomp (r : T → ℕ)
    (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) (σ : Equiv.Perm U) :
    (completeRandomization r hr).map (fun a => fun i => a (σ i))
      = completeRandomization r hr := by
  ext b
  rw [PMF.map_apply, tsum_eq_single (fun i => b (σ.symm i))]
  · have hb : (fun i => (fun k => b (σ.symm k)) (σ i)) = b := by
      funext i; simp
    rw [if_pos hb.symm]
    simp only [completeRandomization]
    by_cases hmem : b ∈ validAllocations (U := U) r
    · rw [PMF.uniformOfFinset_apply_of_mem _ hmem,
        PMF.uniformOfFinset_apply_of_mem _
          ((precomp_mem_validAllocations_iff (r := r) b σ.symm).mpr hmem)]
    · rw [PMF.uniformOfFinset_apply_of_notMem _ hmem,
        PMF.uniformOfFinset_apply_of_notMem _
          (fun h => hmem ((precomp_mem_validAllocations_iff (r := r) b σ.symm).mp h))]
  · intro a ha
    refine if_neg fun h => ha ?_
    subst h
    funext i
    simp
entries.result: PMF.map (fun a i => a (σ i)) (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization r hr) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization r hr
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization_map_precomp
entries.doc:
**Randomisation symmetry**: the completely randomised design is invariant under
relabelling the units by any permutation (`Mead §9.2`: every unit is treated
symmetrically by the random allocation).

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (r : T → ℕ) (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) {i j : U}, i ≠ j → ∀ (t : T), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization r hr) (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t i) (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t j) = -(↑(r t) * (↑(Fintype.card U) - ↑(r t))) / (↑(Fintype.card U) ^ 2 * (↑(Fintype.card U) - 1))
entries.source:
/-- **Negative indicator covariance across units**:
`Cov(χ_{t,i}, χ_{t,j}) = − r_t (N − r_t) / (N² (N−1))` for `i ≠ j` — the fixed arm
sizes make assignments negatively dependent (`Mead §9.4`). -/
theorem cov_armIndicator_of_ne (r : T → ℕ) (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U)
    {i j : U}
    -- LEAN-ONLY: distinct units; the same-unit case is `var_armIndicator`
    (hij : i ≠ j) (t : T) :
    pmfCov (completeRandomization r hr) (armIndicator t i) (armIndicator t j)
      = -((r t : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) - (r t : ℝ)))
          / ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) - 1)) := by
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨i⟩
  have h2 : 2 ≤ Fintype.card U := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff.mpr ⟨i, j, hij⟩
  have hN : (Fintype.card U : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hN1 : (Fintype.card U : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card U : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    linarith
  rw [pmfCov_eq_expect_mul_sub_mul, expect_armIndicator_pair_same r hr hij t,
    expect_armIndicator, expect_armIndicator]
  field_simp
  ring
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization r hr) (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t i) (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t j) = -(↑(r t) * (↑(Fintype.card U) - ↑(r t))) / (↑(Fintype.card U) ^ 2 * (↑(Fintype.card U) - 1))

/-- The covariance of two inclusion indicators: `Cov(𝟙ᵢ, 𝟙ⱼ) = π_{ij} − πᵢ πⱼ`
(`HT52`; the kernel of the Horvitz–Thompson variance). -/
theorem cov_inclusionIndicator (D : SamplingDesign U) (i j : U) :
    pmfCov D (inclusionIndicator i) (inclusionIndicator j)
      = pairInclusionProb D i j - inclusionProb D i * inclusionProb D j := by
  rw [pmfCov_eq_expect_mul_sub_mul]
  rfl

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (r : T → ℕ) (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) (i : U) (t : T), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization r hr) (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t i) = ↑(r t) / ↑(Fintype.card U)
entries.source:
/-- **First-order assignment probability**: each unit receives treatment `t` with
probability `r_t / N` (`Mead §9.6`, allocation probabilities `n_A/∑n`). -/
theorem expect_armIndicator (r : T → ℕ) (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U)
    (i : U) (t : T) :
    pmfExpect (completeRandomization r hr) (armIndicator t i)
      = (r t : ℝ) / (Fintype.card U : ℝ) := by
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨i⟩
  have hN : (Fintype.card U : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hK := card_validAllocations_ne_zero (U := U) r hr
  have key := card_mul_sum_armIndicator r t i
  rw [expect_completeRandomization]
  field_simp
  linarith [key]

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (r : T → ℕ) (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) {i j : U}, i ≠ j → ∀ {t s : T}, t ≠ s → (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization r hr) fun a => StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator t i a * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armIndicator s j a) = ↑(r t) * ↑(r s) / (↑(Fintype.card U) * (↑(Fintype.card U) - 1))
entries.source:
/-- **Second-order assignment probability, distinct treatments**: distinct units
receive `t` and `s ≠ t` with probability `r_t r_s / (N (N−1))` (`Mead §9.4`). -/
theorem expect_armIndicator_pair_distinct (r : T → ℕ)
    (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) {i j : U}
    -- LEAN-ONLY: distinct units; same-unit exclusivity gives probability zero
    (hij : i ≠ j) {t s : T}
    -- LEAN-ONLY: distinct treatments; the same-treatment case is the lemma above
    (hts : t ≠ s) :
    pmfExpect (completeRandomization r hr)
        (fun a => armIndicator t i a * armIndicator s j a)
      = (r t : ℝ) * (r s : ℝ)
          / ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) - 1)) := by
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨i⟩
  have h2 : 2 ≤ Fintype.card U := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff.mpr ⟨i, j, hij⟩
  have hN : (Fintype.card U : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hN1 : (Fintype.card U : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card U : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    linarith
  have hK := card_validAllocations_ne_zero (U := U) r hr
  have hmarg := card_mul_sum_armIndicator r t i
  have hrhs : ∑ a ∈ validAllocations (U := U) r,
        armIndicator t i a * ((r s : ℝ) - armIndicator s i a)
      = (r s : ℝ) * ∑ a ∈ validAllocations (U := U) r, armIndicator t i a := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    rw [mul_sub, armIndicator_mul_armIndicator_of_ne hts i a]
    ring
  have herase := sum_pair_erase r t s i
  rw [sum_pair_card_erase r t s i hij.symm, hrhs] at herase
  have hkey : ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) - 1))
        * ∑ a ∈ validAllocations (U := U) r, armIndicator t i a * armIndicator s j a
      = ((validAllocations (U := U) r).card : ℝ) * ((r t : ℝ) * (r s : ℝ)) := by
    linear_combination (Fintype.card U : ℝ) * herase + (r s : ℝ) * hmarg
  rw [expect_completeRandomization]
  field_simp
  linarith [hkey]

entries.source:
/-- **Second-order assignment probability, same treatment**: distinct units both
receive `t` with probability `r_t (r_t − 1) / (N (N−1))` (`Mead §9.4`, the
`E[δ δ']` pattern). -/
theorem expect_armIndicator_pair_same (r : T → ℕ)
    (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) {i j : U}
    -- LEAN-ONLY: distinct units; the same-unit case is the idempotency identity
    (hij : i ≠ j) (t : T) :
    pmfExpect (completeRandomization r hr)
        (fun a => armIndicator t i a * armIndicator t j a)
      = (r t : ℝ) * ((r t : ℝ) - 1)
          / ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) - 1)) := by
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨i⟩
  have h2 : 2 ≤ Fintype.card U := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff.mpr ⟨i, j, hij⟩
  have hN : (Fintype.card U : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hN1 : (Fintype.card U : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card U : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    linarith
  have hK := card_validAllocations_ne_zero (U := U) r hr
  have hmarg := card_mul_sum_armIndicator r t i
  have hrhs : ∑ a ∈ validAllocations (U := U) r,
        armIndicator t i a * ((r t : ℝ) - armIndicator t i a)
      = ((r t : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ a ∈ validAllocations (U := U) r, armIndicator t i a := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    rw [mul_sub, armIndicator_mul_self]
    ring
  have herase := sum_pair_erase r t t i
  rw [sum_pair_card_erase r t t i hij.symm, hrhs] at herase
  have hkey : ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) * ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) - 1))
        * ∑ a ∈ validAllocations (U := U) r, armIndicator t i a * armIndicator t j a
      = ((validAllocations (U := U) r).card : ℝ) * ((r t : ℝ) * ((r t : ℝ) - 1)) := by
    linear_combination (Fintype.card U : ℝ) * herase + ((r t : ℝ) - 1) * hmarg
  rw [expect_completeRandomization]
  field_simp
  linarith [hkey]

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (r : T → ℕ) (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) (t : T), r t ≠ 0 → ∀ (y : U → ℝ), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.completeRandomization r hr) (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.armMean y t) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean y
entries.source:
/-- **Design unbiasedness of the arm mean**: for a treatment with positive
replication, the arm mean of a deterministic quantity `y` has design expectation the
population mean (`Mead §9.4`, the finite model; no potential outcomes involved). -/
theorem expect_armMean (r : T → ℕ) (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) (t : T)
    -- USER-INPUT: positive replication of the arm, so its mean is well defined; Mead §6.2
    (ht : r t ≠ 0) (y : U → ℝ) :
    pmfExpect (completeRandomization r hr) (armMean y t) = populationMean y := by
  have h1 : pmfExpect (completeRandomization r hr) (armMean y t)
      = pmfExpect ((completeRandomization r hr).map (arm t)) (sampleMean y) := by
    rw [pmfExpect_map]
    exact congrArg _ (funext fun a => armMean_eq_sampleMean_arm y t a)
  rw [h1, completeRandomization_map_arm]
  exact srs_sampleMean_unbiased (r t) (replication_le_card r hr t) ht y

/-- **Expected sample size**: `E_D|S| = ∑ᵢ πᵢ` (`HT52`). -/
theorem expect_sampleCard (D : SamplingDesign U) :
    pmfExpect D (fun s => (s.card : ℝ)) = ∑ i, inclusionProb D i := by
  have h : (fun s : Finset U => (s.card : ℝ))
      = fun s => ∑ i, inclusionIndicator i s := by
    funext s; exact card_sample_eq_sum_indicator s
  rw [h, pmfExpect_sum]
  rfl

entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [Fintype ι] → [DecidableEq ι] → ((ι → Bool) → ℝ) → Finset ι → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **factorial coefficient** of a response function at the effect `S`:
`ŷ(S) = 2^{−k} ∑ₓ y(x) χ_S(x)`.  Equals half the Mead effect for nonempty `S` and
the overall mean for `S = ∅` (see the module docstring for the scaling). -/
noncomputable def factorialCoeff (y : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) : ℝ :=
  ((2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι)⁻¹ * ∑ x, y x * character S x

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (y : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (c : Finset ι → ℝ), (∀ (x : ι → Bool), y x = ∑ S, c S * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character S x) → ∀ (S : Finset ι), c S = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.factorialCoeff y S
entries.source:
/-- **Uniqueness of the factorial coefficients**: any coefficient family reproducing
`y` through the character expansion is the family of factorial coefficients. -/
theorem factorialCoeff_eq_of_expansion (y : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (c : Finset ι → ℝ)
    -- USER-INPUT: a character representation of the response; Mead §13.1
    (h : ∀ x, y x = ∑ S : Finset ι, c S * character S x) (S : Finset ι) :
    c S = factorialCoeff y S := by
  classical
  have h2 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero
  have key : ∑ x, y x * character S x = c S * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
    calc ∑ x, y x * character S x
        = ∑ x, ∑ T : Finset ι, c T * (character T x * character S x) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
          rw [h x, Finset.sum_mul]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ => by ring
      _ = ∑ T : Finset ι, ∑ x, c T * (character T x * character S x) :=
          Finset.sum_comm
      _ = ∑ T : Finset ι, c T * (if T = S then (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι else 0) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ => ?_
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_character_mul]
      _ = ∑ T : Finset ι, (if T = S then c T * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι else 0) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ => by split <;> simp
      _ = c S * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
          rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ S
            (fun T => c T * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ S)]
  unfold factorialCoeff
  rw [key]
  field_simp

params.t: ∀ (x : ι → Bool), y x = ∑ S, c S * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character S x

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (y : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (x : ι → Bool), y x = ∑ S, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.factorialCoeff y S * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character S x
entries.source:
/-- **The factorial expansion** (`Mead §13.1`, the effect representation `y = Ux` in
matrix form): every response function is the character sum of its factorial
coefficients. -/
theorem factorialExpansion (y : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (x : ι → Bool) :
    y x = ∑ S : Finset ι, factorialCoeff y S * character S x := by
  classical
  have h2 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero
  symm
  calc ∑ S : Finset ι, factorialCoeff y S * character S x
      = ∑ S : Finset ι, ((2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι)⁻¹
          * ∑ z, y z * character S z * character S x := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
        unfold factorialCoeff
        rw [mul_assoc]
        congr 1
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι)⁻¹
          * ∑ z, y z * ∑ S : Finset ι, character S z * character S x := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        congr 1
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => ?_
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
        ring
    _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι)⁻¹ * (y x * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι) := by
        congr 1
        calc ∑ z, y z * ∑ S : Finset ι, character S z * character S x
            = ∑ z, y z * (if z = x then (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => by rw [sum_character_point]
          _ = ∑ z, (if z = x then y z * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => by split <;> simp
          _ = y x * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
              rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ x
                (fun z => y z * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ x)]
    _ = y x := by
        field_simp
entries.result: y x = ∑ S, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.factorialCoeff y S * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.character S x

entries.doc:
**The factorial expansion** (`Mead §13.1`, the effect representation `y = Ux` in

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (y : (ι → Bool) → ℝ), ∑ x, y x ^ 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card ι * ∑ S, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.factorialCoeff y S ^ 2
entries.source:
/-- **Parseval for the factorial expansion**: `∑ₓ y(x)² = 2^k ∑_S ŷ(S)²` — the exact
sum-of-squares decomposition of a `2^k` response into effect components
(`Mead §13.1`, the component SS of the effects). -/
theorem factorialParseval (y : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, y x ^ 2
      = (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι * ∑ S : Finset ι, factorialCoeff y S ^ 2 := by
  classical
  have h2 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero
  calc ∑ x, y x ^ 2
      = ∑ x, ∑ S : Finset ι, factorialCoeff y S * (y x * character S x) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
        rw [pow_two]
        nth_rewrite 1 [factorialExpansion y x]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => by ring
    _ = ∑ S : Finset ι, factorialCoeff y S * ∑ x, y x * character S x := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ S : Finset ι, factorialCoeff y S
          * (factorialCoeff y S * (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
        congr 1
        unfold factorialCoeff
        field_simp
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι * ∑ S : Finset ι, factorialCoeff y S ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => by ring
entries.result: ∑ x, y x ^ 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card ι * ∑ S, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.factorialCoeff y S ^ 2
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.factorialParseval

of the whole population. -/

    Allocation U T :=
  fun i => ω (bl i) ⟨i, rfl⟩

entries.statement: {U : Type u_1} → [Fintype U] → [DecidableEq U] → StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U → (U → ℝ) → Finset U → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **Horvitz–Thompson estimator** of the population total: `∑_{i ∈ S} yᵢ/πᵢ`
(`HT52`).  Edge behaviour: units with `πᵢ = 0` contribute `0` by the division
convention; the moment theorems assume `πᵢ > 0`. -/
noncomputable def horvitzThompson (D : SamplingDesign U) (y : U → ℝ)
    (s : Finset U) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ s, y i / inclusionProb D i
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.horvitzThompson
entries.doc:
The **Horvitz–Thompson estimator** of the population total: `∑_{i ∈ S} yᵢ/πᵢ`
(`HT52`).  Edge behaviour: units with `πᵢ = 0` contribute `0` by the division
convention; the moment theorems assume `πᵢ > 0`.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] (D : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U) (y : U → ℝ) (s : Finset U), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.horvitzThompson D y s = ∑ i, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionIndicator i s * (y i / StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i)
entries.source:
/-- Indicator representation of the Horvitz–Thompson estimator. -/
theorem horvitzThompson_eq_sum_indicator (D : SamplingDesign U) (y : U → ℝ)
    (s : Finset U) :
    horvitzThompson D y s
      = ∑ i, inclusionIndicator i s * (y i / inclusionProb D i) := by
  exact sum_sample_eq_sum_indicator (fun i => y i / inclusionProb D i) s
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.horvitzThompson D y s = ∑ i, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionIndicator i s * (y i / StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.horvitzThompson_eq_sum_indicator
entries.doc: Indicator representation of the Horvitz–Thompson estimator.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] (D : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U) (y : U → ℝ), (∀ (i : U), 0 < StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i) → StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.horvitzThompson D y) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationTotal y
entries.source:
/-- **Design unbiasedness of Horvitz–Thompson** (`HT52`, Theorem 1): if every unit
has positive inclusion probability, the estimator's design expectation is the
population total. -/
theorem horvitzThompson_unbiased (D : SamplingDesign U) (y : U → ℝ)
    -- USER-INPUT: strictly positive inclusion probabilities (measurable design); HT52
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < inclusionProb D i) :
    pmfExpect D (horvitzThompson D y) = populationTotal y := by
  have h : horvitzThompson D y
      = fun s => ∑ i, (y i / inclusionProb D i) * inclusionIndicator i s := by
    funext s
    rw [horvitzThompson_eq_sum_indicator]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _
  rw [h, pmfExpect_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [pmfExpect_smul]
  exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hpos i).ne'
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.horvitzThompson_unbiased
entries.doc:
**Design unbiasedness of Horvitz–Thompson** (`HT52`, Theorem 1): if every unit
has positive inclusion probability, the estimator's design expectation is the
population total.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] (D : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U) (y : U → ℝ), (∀ (i : U), 0 < StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i) → StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.horvitzThompson D y) = ∑ i, ∑ j, (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb D i j - StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D j) / (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D j) * (y i * y j)
entries.source:
/-- **Exact design variance of Horvitz–Thompson** (`HT52`, §5):
`Var(Ŷ_HT) = ∑ᵢ ∑ⱼ ((π_{ij} − πᵢ πⱼ)/(πᵢ πⱼ)) yᵢ yⱼ`, diagonal `π_{ii} = πᵢ`. -/
theorem horvitzThompson_variance (D : SamplingDesign U) (y : U → ℝ)
    -- USER-INPUT: strictly positive inclusion probabilities (measurable design); HT52
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < inclusionProb D i) :
    pmfVar D (horvitzThompson D y)
      = ∑ i, ∑ j,
          (pairInclusionProb D i j - inclusionProb D i * inclusionProb D j)
            / (inclusionProb D i * inclusionProb D j) * (y i * y j) := by
  have h : horvitzThompson D y
      = fun s => ∑ i, (y i / inclusionProb D i) * inclusionIndicator i s := by
    funext s
    rw [horvitzThompson_eq_sum_indicator]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _
  rw [h, pmfVar_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [pmfCov_smul_smul, cov_inclusionIndicator]
  have hi := (hpos i).ne'
  have hj := (hpos j).ne'
  field_simp
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.horvitzThompson D y) = ∑ i, ∑ j, (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb D i j - StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D j) / (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D j) * (y i * y j)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.horvitzThompson_variance
entries.doc:
**Exact design variance of Horvitz–Thompson** (`HT52`, §5):
`Var(Ŷ_HT) = ∑ᵢ ∑ⱼ ((π_{ij} − πᵢ πⱼ)/(πᵢ πⱼ)) yᵢ yⱼ`, diagonal `π_{ii} = πᵢ`.

entries.statement: {U : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq U] → U → Finset U → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **inclusion indicator** `1{i ∈ S}` of a unit in a sample, as a real number
(the survey-sampling analogue of `armIndicator`). -/
def inclusionIndicator (i : U) (s : Finset U) : ℝ :=
  if i ∈ s then 1 else 0
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionIndicator
entries.doc:
The **inclusion indicator** `1{i ∈ S}` of a unit in a sample, as a real number
(the survey-sampling analogue of `armIndicator`).

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [Fintype U] [inst : DecidableEq U] (i : U) (s : Finset U), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionIndicator i s * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionIndicator i s = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionIndicator i s
entries.source:
/-- Inclusion indicators are idempotent (`0/1`-valued). -/
theorem inclusionIndicator_mul_self (i : U) (s : Finset U) :
    inclusionIndicator i s * inclusionIndicator i s = inclusionIndicator i s := by
  unfold inclusionIndicator
  split <;> ring

entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionIndicator_mul_self
entries.doc: Inclusion indicators are idempotent (`0/1`-valued).

entries.statement: {U : Type u_1} → [Fintype U] → [DecidableEq U] → StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U → U → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **first-order inclusion probability** `πᵢ = P_D(i ∈ S)` of a unit under a
sampling design (`HT52`). -/
noncomputable def inclusionProb (D : SamplingDesign U) (i : U) : ℝ :=
  pmfExpect D (inclusionIndicator i)

entries.doc:
The **first-order inclusion probability** `πᵢ = P_D(i ∈ S)` of a unit under a

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] (D : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U) (i : U), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i ≤ 1
entries.source:
/-- Inclusion probabilities are at most one. -/
theorem inclusionProb_le_one (D : SamplingDesign U) (i : U) :
    inclusionProb D i ≤ 1 := by
  refine le_trans (pmfExpect_mono D (g := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ?_) ?_
  · exact fun s => inclusionIndicator_le_one i s
  · exact le_of_eq (pmfExpect_const D 1)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb_le_one
entries.doc: Inclusion probabilities are at most one.

entries.source:
/-- Inclusion probabilities are nonnegative. -/
theorem inclusionProb_nonneg (D : SamplingDesign U) (i : U) :
    0 ≤ inclusionProb D i :=
  pmfExpect_nonneg D fun s => inclusionIndicator_nonneg i s

entries.statement: {U : Type u_1} → [Fintype U] → [DecidableEq U] → StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U → U → U → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **second-order inclusion probability** `π_{ij} = P_D(i ∈ S, j ∈ S)` of a pair
of units (`HT52`).  Diagonal convention: `π_{ii} = πᵢ`
(`pairInclusionProb_self`). -/
noncomputable def pairInclusionProb (D : SamplingDesign U) (i j : U) : ℝ :=
  pmfExpect D fun s => inclusionIndicator i s * inclusionIndicator j s
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb
entries.doc:
The **second-order inclusion probability** `π_{ij} = P_D(i ∈ S, j ∈ S)` of a pair
of units (`HT52`).  Diagonal convention: `π_{ii} = πᵢ`
(`pairInclusionProb_self`).

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] (D : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U) (i j : U), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb D i j = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb D j i
entries.source:
/-- Symmetry of the second-order inclusion probability. -/
theorem pairInclusionProb_comm (D : SamplingDesign U) (i j : U) :
    pairInclusionProb D i j = pairInclusionProb D j i := by
  unfold pairInclusionProb
  congr 1
  funext s
  ring
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb D i j = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb D j i
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb_comm
entries.doc: Symmetry of the second-order inclusion probability.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] (D : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U) (i j : U), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb D i j ≤ StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i
entries.source:
/-- A pair is included no more often than either of its members. -/
theorem pairInclusionProb_le_left (D : SamplingDesign U) (i j : U) :
    pairInclusionProb D i j ≤ inclusionProb D i := by
  refine pmfExpect_mono D (f := fun s => inclusionIndicator i s * inclusionIndicator j s)
    (g := inclusionIndicator i) fun s => ?_
  calc inclusionIndicator i s * inclusionIndicator j s
      ≤ inclusionIndicator i s * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inclusionIndicator_le_one j s) (inclusionIndicator_nonneg i s)
    _ = inclusionIndicator i s := mul_one _
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb D i j ≤ StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb_le_left
entries.doc: A pair is included no more often than either of its members.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] (D : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U) (i j : U), 0 ≤ StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb D i j
entries.source:
/-- Second-order inclusion probabilities are nonnegative. -/
theorem pairInclusionProb_nonneg (D : SamplingDesign U) (i j : U) :
    0 ≤ pairInclusionProb D i j :=
  pmfExpect_nonneg D fun s =>
    mul_nonneg (inclusionIndicator_nonneg i s) (inclusionIndicator_nonneg j s)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb_nonneg
entries.doc: Second-order inclusion probabilities are nonnegative.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U] (D : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.SamplingDesign U) (i : U), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairInclusionProb D i i = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.inclusionProb D i
entries.source:
/-- Diagonal of the second-order inclusion probability: `π_{ii} = πᵢ`. -/
theorem pairInclusionProb_self (D : SamplingDesign U) (i : U) :
    pairInclusionProb D i i = inclusionProb D i := by
  unfold pairInclusionProb inclusionProb
  congr 1
  funext s
  exact inclusionIndicator_mul_self i s

entries.doc: Diagonal of the second-order inclusion probability: `π_{ii} = πᵢ`.

entries.statement: {T : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype T] → [DecidableEq T] → (t₁ t₂ : T) → t₁ ≠ t₂ → StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Contrast T
entries.source:
/-- The **pairwise contrast** comparing treatments `t₁` and `t₂`: coefficients `+1`
at `t₁`, `−1` at `t₂`, `0` elsewhere (`Mead §4.7`, the simple comparison
`t₁ − t₂`). -/
noncomputable def pairwiseContrast (t₁ t₂ : T)
    -- LEAN-ONLY: distinct treatments; for `t₁ = t₂` the coefficients cancel to the
    -- zero contrast and the evaluation lemma below would still hold trivially
    (h : t₁ ≠ t₂) : Contrast T :=
  ⟨fun t => (if t = t₁ then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if t = t₂ then (1 : ℝ) else 0),
    by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ t₁ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)),
      Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ t₂ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))]; simp⟩
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pairwiseContrast
entries.doc:
The **pairwise contrast** comparing treatments `t₁` and `t₂`: coefficients `+1`
at `t₁`, `−1` at `t₂`, `0` elsewhere (`Mead §4.7`, the simple comparison
`t₁ − t₂`).

entries.statement: {Ω : Type u_1} → [Fintype Ω] → PMF Ω → (Ω → ℝ) → (Ω → ℝ) → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **covariance** of two real statistics under a finite PMF, in centered form
`E[(f − E f)(g − E g)]`. -/
noncomputable def pmfCov (D : PMF Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pmfExpect D fun ω => (f ω - pmfExpect D f) * (g ω - pmfExpect D g)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov
entries.doc:
The **covariance** of two real statistics under a finite PMF, in centered form
`E[(f − E f)(g − E g)]`.

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (D : PMF Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov D f g = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov D g f
entries.source:
/-- Symmetry of the covariance. -/
theorem pmfCov_comm (D : PMF Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) : pmfCov D f g = pmfCov D g f := by
  simp only [pmfCov, pmfExpect]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => by ring
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov D f g = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov D g f
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov_comm
entries.doc: Symmetry of the covariance.

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (D : PMF Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov D f g = (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D fun ω => f ω * g ω) - StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D f * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D g
entries.source:
/-- Computational form of the covariance: `Cov(f,g) = E[fg] − (E f)(E g)`. -/
theorem pmfCov_eq_expect_mul_sub_mul (D : PMF Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    pmfCov D f g = pmfExpect D (fun ω => f ω * g ω) - pmfExpect D f * pmfExpect D g := by
  rw [pmfCov, pmfExpect_centered_mul]
  ring
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov D f g = (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D fun ω => f ω * g ω) - StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D f * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D g
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov_eq_expect_mul_sub_mul
entries.doc: Computational form of the covariance: `Cov(f,g) = E[fg] − (E f)(E g)`.

entries.statement: ∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B] {Ω : B → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (b : B) → Fintype (Ω b)] [inst_3 : (b : B) → DecidableEq (Ω b)] (D : (b : B) → PMF (Ω b)) {b b' : B}, b ≠ b' → ∀ (f : Ω b → ℝ) (g : Ω b' → ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign D) (fun ω => f (ω b)) fun ω => g (ω b')) = 0
entries.source:
/-- **Independence across strata**: statistics of distinct strata are
uncorrelated. -/
theorem pmfCov_productDesign_of_ne (D : ∀ b, PMF (Ω b)) {b b' : B}
    -- LEAN-ONLY: distinct strata; within one stratum the covariance is unconstrained
    (hbb' : b ≠ b') (f : Ω b → ℝ) (g : Ω b' → ℝ) :
    pmfCov (productDesign D) (fun ω => f (ω b)) (fun ω => g (ω b')) = 0 := by
  classical
  have h1 : pmfExpect (productDesign D) (fun ω => f (ω b)) = pmfExpect (D b) f :=
    pmfExpect_productDesign_comp D b f
  have h2 : pmfExpect (productDesign D) (fun ω => g (ω b')) = pmfExpect (D b') g :=
    pmfExpect_productDesign_comp D b' g
  have key : pmfCov (productDesign D) (fun ω => f (ω b)) (fun ω => g (ω b'))
      = pmfExpect (productDesign D)
          (fun ω => (f (ω b) - pmfExpect (D b) f) * (g (ω b') - pmfExpect (D b') g)) := by
    unfold pmfCov
    rw [h1, h2]
  rw [key]
  calc pmfExpect (productDesign D)
        (fun ω => (f (ω b) - pmfExpect (D b) f) * (g (ω b') - pmfExpect (D b') g))
      = pmfExpect (D b) (fun x => f x - pmfExpect (D b) f)
          * pmfExpect (D b') (fun x => g x - pmfExpect (D b') g) :=
        pmfExpect_productDesign_mul D hbb' (fun x => f x - pmfExpect (D b) f)
          (fun x => g x - pmfExpect (D b') g)
    _ = 0 := by
        rw [pmfExpect_sub, pmfExpect_const, sub_self, zero_mul]
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign D) (fun ω => f (ω b)) fun ω => g (ω b')) = 0
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov_productDesign_of_ne
entries.doc:
**Independence across strata**: statistics of distinct strata are
uncorrelated.

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (D : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov D f f = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D f
entries.source:
/-- The covariance of a statistic with itself is its variance. -/
theorem pmfCov_self (D : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) : pmfCov D f f = pmfVar D f := by
  rw [pmfCov_eq_expect_mul_sub_mul, pmfVar_eq_expect_sq_sub_sq]
  rw [congrArg (pmfExpect D) (funext fun ω => (sq (f ω)).symm), sq]
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov D f f = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D f
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov_self
entries.doc: The covariance of a statistic with itself is its variance.

/-- Bilinear scaling of the covariance. -/
theorem pmfCov_smul_smul (D : PMF Ω) (a b : ℝ) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    pmfCov D (fun ω => a * f ω) (fun ω => b * g ω) = a * b * pmfCov D f g := by
  simp only [pmfCov, pmfExpect_smul]
  conv_rhs => rw [← pmfExpect_smul]
  exact congrArg (pmfExpect D) (funext fun ω => by ring)

entries.statement: {Ω : Type u_1} → [Fintype Ω] → PMF Ω → (Ω → ℝ) → ℝ

/-- The **expectation** of a real statistic `f` under a probability mass function `D`
on a finite type: `∑ ω, D(ω) · f(ω)`, with the `ℝ≥0∞`-valued mass converted by
`toReal`.  This is the design expectation of design-based inference (`Mead §9.4`). -/
noncomputable def pmfExpect (D : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ ω, (D ω).toReal * f ω

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] {Ω' : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype Ω'] (D : PMF Ω) (g : Ω → Ω') (f : Ω' → ℝ), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (PMF.map g D) f = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D fun ω => f (g ω)
entries.source:
/-- **Pushforward identity**: the expectation of `f` under the image design `D.map g`
is the expectation of `f ∘ g` under `D`.  This is the workhorse that transfers moment
computations along design reductions (e.g. from a randomization design to the induced
sampling design of one treatment arm). -/
theorem pmfExpect_map {Ω' : Type*} [Fintype Ω'] (D : PMF Ω) (g : Ω → Ω') (f : Ω' → ℝ) :
    pmfExpect (D.map g) f = pmfExpect D (fun ω => f (g ω)) := by
  classical
  have key : ∀ b : Ω',
      ((D.map g) b).toReal = ∑ ω, if b = g ω then (D ω).toReal else 0 := by
    intro b
    rw [PMF.map_apply, tsum_fintype, ENNReal.toReal_sum]
    · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => by split <;> simp
    · intro ω _
      split
      · exact D.apply_ne_top ω
      · simp
  simp only [pmfExpect, key, Finset.sum_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => by simp
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (PMF.map g D) f = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D fun ω => f (g ω)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect_map
entries.doc:
**Pushforward identity**: the expectation of `f` under the image design `D.map g`

sampling design of one treatment arm).

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (D : PMF Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ}, (∀ (ω : Ω), f ω ≤ g ω) → StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D f ≤ StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D g
entries.source:
/-- Monotonicity of the design expectation. -/
theorem pmfExpect_mono (D : PMF Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ}
    -- LEAN-ONLY: pointwise domination; monotonicity transport, no scope change
    (h : ∀ ω, f ω ≤ g ω) :
    pmfExpect D f ≤ pmfExpect D g :=
  Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h ω) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D f ≤ StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D g
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect_mono
entries.doc: Monotonicity of the design expectation.

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (D : PMF Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ}, (∀ (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ f ω) → 0 ≤ StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D f
entries.source:
/-- The design expectation of a pointwise-nonnegative statistic is nonnegative. -/
theorem pmfExpect_nonneg (D : PMF Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ}
    -- LEAN-ONLY: pointwise nonnegativity; positivity transport, no scope change
    (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) :
    0 ≤ pmfExpect D f :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun ω _ => mul_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (hf ω)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect_nonneg
entries.doc: The design expectation of a pointwise-nonnegative statistic is nonnegative.

entries.statement: ∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B] {Ω : B → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (b : B) → Fintype (Ω b)] [inst_3 : (b : B) → DecidableEq (Ω b)] (D : (b : B) → PMF (Ω b)) (b₀ : B) (f : Ω b₀ → ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign D) fun ω => f (ω b₀)) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (D b₀) f
entries.source:
/-- **Marginals of the product design**: a statistic of one stratum has its
single-stratum expectation. -/
theorem pmfExpect_productDesign_comp (D : ∀ b, PMF (Ω b)) (b₀ : B)
    (f : Ω b₀ → ℝ) :
    pmfExpect (productDesign D) (fun ω => f (ω b₀)) = pmfExpect (D b₀) f := by
  classical
  set F : ∀ b, Ω b → ℝ := Function.update (fun b => fun _ : Ω b => (1 : ℝ)) b₀ f
    with hF
  have hFb₀ : F b₀ = f := by rw [hF, Function.update_self]
  have hFne : ∀ b, b ≠ b₀ → F b = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := fun b hb => by
    rw [hF, Function.update_of_ne hb]
  unfold pmfExpect
  calc ∑ ω : ∀ b, Ω b, (productDesign D ω).toReal * f (ω b₀)
      = ∑ ω : ∀ b, Ω b, ∏ b, ((D b (ω b)).toReal * F b (ω b)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
        have hprodF : (∏ b, F b (ω b)) = f (ω b₀) := by
          rw [Finset.prod_eq_single b₀ (fun b _ hb => by rw [hFne b hb])
            (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ b₀) h), hFb₀]
        rw [productDesign_apply, ENNReal.toReal_prod, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, hprodF]
    _ = ∏ b, ∑ x, (D b x).toReal * F b x :=
        sum_pi_prod fun b x => (D b x).toReal * F b x
    _ = ∑ x, (D b₀ x).toReal * f x := by
        rw [Finset.prod_eq_single b₀ (fun b _ hb => by
            rw [hFne b hb]
            simpa using sum_pmf_toReal (D b))
          (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ b₀) h), hFb₀]
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign D) fun ω => f (ω b₀)) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (D b₀) f
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect_productDesign_comp
entries.doc:
**Marginals of the product design**: a statistic of one stratum has its
single-stratum expectation.

entries.statement: ∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B] {Ω : B → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (b : B) → Fintype (Ω b)] [inst_3 : (b : B) → DecidableEq (Ω b)] (D : (b : B) → PMF (Ω b)) (f : (b : B) → Ω b → ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign D) fun ω => ∏ b, f b (ω b)) = ∏ b, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (D b) (f b)
entries.source:
/-- **Factorization over strata**: the expectation of a product of per-stratum
statistics is the product of expectations. -/
theorem pmfExpect_productDesign_prod (D : ∀ b, PMF (Ω b))
    (f : ∀ b, Ω b → ℝ) :
    pmfExpect (productDesign D) (fun ω => ∏ b, f b (ω b))
      = ∏ b, pmfExpect (D b) (f b) := by
  classical
  unfold pmfExpect
  calc ∑ ω : ∀ b, Ω b, (productDesign D ω).toReal * ∏ b, f b (ω b)
      = ∑ ω : ∀ b, Ω b, ∏ b, ((D b (ω b)).toReal * f b (ω b)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
        rw [productDesign_apply, ENNReal.toReal_prod, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    _ = ∏ b, ∑ x, (D b x).toReal * f b x :=
        sum_pi_prod fun b x => (D b x).toReal * f b x
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign D) fun ω => ∏ b, f b (ω b)) = ∏ b, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect (D b) (f b)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect_productDesign_prod
entries.doc:
**Factorization over strata**: the expectation of a product of per-stratum
statistics is the product of expectations.

/-- Counting formula for the expectation under the uniform law on a finite set of
outcomes: the average of `f` over the set. -/

  simp only [pmfExpect, PMF.uniformOfFinset_apply, apply_ite ENNReal.toReal,
    ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast, ENNReal.toReal_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter, Finset.mul_sum]

entries.statement: {Ω : Type u_1} → [Fintype Ω] → PMF Ω → (Ω → ℝ) → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **variance** of a real statistic under a finite PMF, in centered form
`E[(f − E f)²]`.  Degenerate inputs need no side conditions: this is a finite sum of
nonnegative terms. -/
noncomputable def pmfVar (D : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  pmfExpect D fun ω => (f ω - pmfExpect D f) ^ 2
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar
entries.doc:
The **variance** of a real statistic under a finite PMF, in centered form
`E[(f − E f)²]`.  Degenerate inputs need no side conditions: this is a finite sum of
nonnegative terms.

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (D : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D fun ω => f ω + c) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D f
entries.source:
/-- Translation invariance of the variance. -/
theorem pmfVar_add_const (D : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    pmfVar D (fun ω => f ω + c) = pmfVar D f := by
  have h : pmfExpect D (fun ω => f ω + c) = pmfExpect D f + c := by
    rw [pmfExpect_add, pmfExpect_const]
  simp only [pmfVar, h]
  exact congrArg (pmfExpect D) (funext fun ω => by ring)
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D fun ω => f ω + c) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D f
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar_add_const
entries.doc: Translation invariance of the variance.

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (D : PMF Ω) (c : ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D fun x => c) = 0
entries.source:
/-- The variance of a constant statistic vanishes. -/
theorem pmfVar_const (D : PMF Ω) (c : ℝ) : pmfVar D (fun _ => c) = 0 := by
  have hrw : (fun _ : Ω => (c - pmfExpect D (fun _ : Ω => c)) ^ 2) = fun _ : Ω => (0 : ℝ) := by
    funext ω; rw [pmfExpect_const]; ring
  rw [pmfVar, hrw, pmfExpect_const]
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar_const
entries.doc: The variance of a constant statistic vanishes.

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (D : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D f = (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D fun ω => f ω ^ 2) - StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D f ^ 2
entries.source:
/-- Computational form of the variance: `Var f = E[f²] − (E f)²`. -/
theorem pmfVar_eq_expect_sq_sub_sq (D : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    pmfVar D f = pmfExpect D (fun ω => f ω ^ 2) - (pmfExpect D f) ^ 2 := by
  have h : pmfVar D f = pmfExpect D (fun ω => (f ω - pmfExpect D f) * (f ω - pmfExpect D f)) := by
    rw [pmfVar]
    exact congrArg (pmfExpect D) (funext fun ω => sq (f ω - pmfExpect D f))
  rw [h, pmfExpect_centered_mul]
  have h2 : pmfExpect D (fun ω => f ω * f ω) = pmfExpect D (fun ω => f ω ^ 2) :=
    congrArg (pmfExpect D) (funext fun ω => (sq (f ω)).symm)
  rw [h2]
  ring
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D f = (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D fun ω => f ω ^ 2) - StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfExpect D f ^ 2
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar_eq_expect_sq_sub_sq
entries.doc: Computational form of the variance: `Var f = E[f²] − (E f)²`.

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (D : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ), 0 ≤ StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D f
entries.source:
/-- The design variance is nonnegative. -/
theorem pmfVar_nonneg (D : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) : 0 ≤ pmfVar D f :=
  pmfExpect_nonneg D fun _ => sq_nonneg _
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar_nonneg
entries.doc: The design variance is nonnegative.

entries.statement: ∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B] {Ω : B → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (b : B) → Fintype (Ω b)] [inst_3 : (b : B) → DecidableEq (Ω b)] (D : (b : B) → PMF (Ω b)) (b₀ : B) (f : Ω b₀ → ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign D) fun ω => f (ω b₀)) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar (D b₀) f
entries.source:
/-- The variance of a single-stratum statistic under the product design is its
single-stratum variance. -/
theorem pmfVar_productDesign_comp (D : ∀ b, PMF (Ω b)) (b₀ : B)
    (f : Ω b₀ → ℝ) :
    pmfVar (productDesign D) (fun ω => f (ω b₀)) = pmfVar (D b₀) f := by
  classical
  have hm : pmfExpect (productDesign D) (fun ω => f (ω b₀)) = pmfExpect (D b₀) f :=
    pmfExpect_productDesign_comp D b₀ f
  unfold pmfVar
  rw [hm]
  exact pmfExpect_productDesign_comp D b₀ fun x => (f x - pmfExpect (D b₀) f) ^ 2
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign D) fun ω => f (ω b₀)) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar (D b₀) f
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar_productDesign_comp
entries.doc:
The variance of a single-stratum statistic under the product design is its
single-stratum variance.

entries.statement: ∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype B] [inst_1 : DecidableEq B] {Ω : B → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (b : B) → Fintype (Ω b)] [inst_3 : (b : B) → DecidableEq (Ω b)] (D : (b : B) → PMF (Ω b)) (f : (b : B) → Ω b → ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign D) fun ω => ∑ b, f b (ω b)) = ∑ b, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar (D b) (f b)
entries.source:
/-- **Additivity of variance over strata** (`Mead §9.4`, no cross-block terms):
the variance of a sum of per-stratum statistics is the sum of the per-stratum
variances. -/
theorem pmfVar_productDesign_sum (D : ∀ b, PMF (Ω b)) (f : ∀ b, Ω b → ℝ) :
    pmfVar (productDesign D) (fun ω => ∑ b, f b (ω b))
      = ∑ b, pmfVar (D b) (f b) := by
  classical
  rw [pmfVar_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b]
  · rw [pmfCov_self]
    exact pmfVar_productDesign_comp D b (f b)
  · intro b' _ hb'
    exact pmfCov_productDesign_of_ne D (Ne.symm hb') (f b) (f b')
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b) h
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign D) fun ω => ∑ b, f b (ω b)) = ∑ b, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar (D b) (f b)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar_productDesign_sum
entries.doc:
**Additivity of variance over strata** (`Mead §9.4`, no cross-block terms):
the variance of a sum of per-stratum statistics is the sum of the per-stratum
variances.

/-- Quadratic scaling of the variance. -/
theorem pmfVar_smul (D : PMF Ω) (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    pmfVar D (fun ω => c * f ω) = c ^ 2 * pmfVar D f := by
  simp only [pmfVar, pmfExpect_smul]
  conv_rhs => rw [← pmfExpect_smul]
  exact congrArg (pmfExpect D) (funext fun ω => by ring)

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (D : PMF Ω) {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, f i ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov D (f i) (f j)
entries.source:
/-- **Variance of a sum** as the double sum of covariances:
`Var(∑ i, fᵢ) = ∑ i, ∑ j, Cov(fᵢ, fⱼ)`.  The single identity behind every exact design
variance in the library (Horvitz–Thompson, arm means, stratified estimators). -/
theorem pmfVar_sum (D : PMF Ω) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    pmfVar D (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, f i ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, pmfCov D (f i) (f j) := by
  have hE : pmfExpect D (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, f i ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, pmfExpect D (f i) :=
    pmfExpect_sum D s f
  have hpt : (fun ω => (∑ i ∈ s, f i ω - pmfExpect D (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, f i ω)) ^ 2)
      = fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s,
          (f i ω - pmfExpect D (f i)) * (f j ω - pmfExpect D (f j)) := by
    funext ω
    rw [hE, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  rw [pmfVar, hpt, pmfExpect_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [pmfExpect_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => rfl
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar D fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, f i ω) = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfCov D (f i) (f j)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.pmfVar_sum
entries.doc:
**Variance of a sum** as the double sum of covariances:
`Var(∑ i, fᵢ) = ∑ i, ∑ j, Cov(fᵢ, fⱼ)`.  The single identity behind every exact design
variance in the library (Horvitz–Thompson, arm means, stratified estimators).

entries.statement: {U : Type u_1} → [Fintype U] → (U → ℝ) → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **population mean** `ȳ = N⁻¹ ∑ᵢ yᵢ`.  Edge behaviour: `0` for the empty
population (`(0:ℝ)⁻¹ = 0`). -/
noncomputable def populationMean (y : U → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Fintype.card U : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, y i
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean
entries.doc:
The **population mean** `ȳ = N⁻¹ ∑ᵢ yᵢ`.  Edge behaviour: `0` for the empty
population (`(0:ℝ)⁻¹ = 0`).

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] (y z : U → ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean fun i => y i + z i) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean y + StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean z
entries.source:
/-- Additivity of the population mean. -/
theorem populationMean_add (y z : U → ℝ) :
    populationMean (fun i => y i + z i) = populationMean y + populationMean z := by
  rw [populationMean, populationMean, populationMean, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add]
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean fun i => y i + z i) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean y + StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean z
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean_add
entries.doc: Additivity of the population mean.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] [Nonempty U] (c : ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean fun x => c) = c
entries.source:
/-- The population mean of a constant is that constant. -/
theorem populationMean_const [Nonempty U] (c : ℝ) :
    populationMean (fun _ : U => c) = c := by
  rw [populationMean, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (card_ne_zero_real U), one_mul]
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean_const
entries.doc: The population mean of a constant is that constant.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] (c : ℝ) (y : U → ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean fun i => c * y i) = c * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean y
entries.source:
/-- Homogeneity of the population mean. -/
theorem populationMean_smul (c : ℝ) (y : U → ℝ) :
    populationMean (fun i => c * y i) = c * populationMean y := by
  rw [populationMean, populationMean, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean fun i => c * y i) = c * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean y
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean_smul
entries.doc: Homogeneity of the population mean.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] [Nonempty U] (st : U → B) (y : U → ℝ), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean y = ∑ b, ↑(Fintype.card (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Stratum st b)) / ↑(Fintype.card U) * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean fun i => y ↑i
entries.source:
/-- The population mean is the size-weighted average of the stratum means:
`ȳ = ∑_b (N_b / N) ȳ_b`.  Empty strata contribute `0` through their vanishing
weight. -/
theorem populationMean_stratified
    -- LEAN-ONLY: nonempty population, so the global size `N` is invertible
    [Nonempty U] (st : U → B) (y : U → ℝ) :
    populationMean y
      = ∑ b, (Fintype.card (Stratum st b) : ℝ) / (Fintype.card U : ℝ)
          * populationMean (fun i : Stratum st b => y i) := by
  have h : ∀ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset B),
      (Fintype.card (Stratum st b) : ℝ) / (Fintype.card U : ℝ)
          * populationMean (fun i : Stratum st b => y i)
        = (Fintype.card U : ℝ)⁻¹ * populationTotal (fun i : Stratum st b => y i) := by
    intro b _
    rw [populationTotal_eq_card_mul_mean]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← populationTotal_stratified,
    populationTotal, populationMean]
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean y = ∑ b, ↑(Fintype.card (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Stratum st b)) / ↑(Fintype.card U) * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean fun i => y ↑i
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean_stratified
entries.doc:
The population mean is the size-weighted average of the stratum means:
`ȳ = ∑_b (N_b / N) ȳ_b`.  Empty strata contribute `0` through their vanishing
weight.

entries.statement: {U : Type u_1} → [Fintype U] → (U → ℝ) → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **population total** `Y = ∑ᵢ yᵢ` of a deterministic finite-population quantity
(`Mead §9.4`, the finite model). -/
noncomputable def populationTotal (y : U → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, y i
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationTotal
entries.doc:
The **population total** `Y = ∑ᵢ yᵢ` of a deterministic finite-population quantity
(`Mead §9.4`, the finite model).

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] (y : U → ℝ), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationTotal y = ↑(Fintype.card U) * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationMean y
entries.source:
/-- The total is `N` times the mean (degenerately `0 = 0` for the empty population). -/
theorem populationTotal_eq_card_mul_mean (y : U → ℝ) :
    populationTotal y = (Fintype.card U : ℝ) * populationMean y := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty U with hU | hU
  · simp [populationTotal, populationMean, Fintype.card_eq_zero]
  · rw [populationMean, populationTotal, ← mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (card_ne_zero_real U), one_mul]
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationTotal_eq_card_mul_mean
entries.doc: The total is `N` times the mean (degenerately `0 = 0` for the empty population).

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype B] [inst_3 : DecidableEq B] (st : U → B) (y : U → ℝ), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationTotal y = ∑ b, StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationTotal fun i => y ↑i
entries.source:
/-- The population total decomposes as the sum of stratum totals. -/
theorem populationTotal_stratified (st : U → B) (y : U → ℝ) :
    populationTotal y = ∑ b, populationTotal (fun i : Stratum st b => y i) := by
  rw [populationTotal]
  exact (Fintype.sum_fiberwise st y).symm
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationTotal_stratified
entries.doc: The population total decomposes as the sum of stratum totals.

entries.statement: {U : Type u_1} → [Fintype U] → (U → ℝ) → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **finite-population variance** `S² = (N−1)⁻¹ ∑ᵢ (yᵢ − ȳ)²`, with the survey-
sampling `N − 1` normalisation.  Edge behaviour: `0` when `N ≤ 1`. -/
noncomputable def populationVariance (y : U → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((Fintype.card U : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (y i - populationMean y) ^ 2
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance
entries.doc:
The **finite-population variance** `S² = (N−1)⁻¹ ∑ᵢ (yᵢ − ȳ)²`, with the survey-
sampling `N − 1` normalisation.  Edge behaviour: `0` when `N ≤ 1`.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] (y : U → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance fun i => y i + c) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance y
entries.source:
/-- Translation invariance of the finite-population variance. -/
theorem populationVariance_add_const (y : U → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    populationVariance (fun i => y i + c) = populationVariance y := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty U with hU | hU
  · simp [populationVariance]
  · have hm : populationMean (fun i => y i + c) = populationMean y + c := by
      rw [populationMean_add, populationMean_const]
    have hs : ∑ i, (y i + c - (populationMean y + c)) ^ 2
        = ∑ i, (y i - populationMean y) ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
    simp only [populationVariance, hm, hs]
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance fun i => y i + c) = StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance y
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance_add_const
entries.doc: Translation invariance of the finite-population variance.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] (c : ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance fun x => c) = 0
entries.source:
/-- The finite-population variance of a constant vanishes. -/
theorem populationVariance_const (c : ℝ) :
    populationVariance (fun _ : U => c) = 0 := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty U with hU | hU
  · simp [populationVariance]
  · have hterm : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset U),
        (c - populationMean (fun _ : U => c)) ^ 2 = (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro i _; rw [populationMean_const]; ring
    rw [populationVariance, Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero]
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance_const
entries.doc: The finite-population variance of a constant vanishes.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U], 2 ≤ Fintype.card U → ∀ (y : U → ℝ), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance y = 0 ↔ ∀ (i j : U), y i = y j
entries.source:
/-- For a population with at least two units, zero variance characterises constancy. -/
theorem populationVariance_eq_zero_iff
    -- LEAN-ONLY: rules out the `N ≤ 1` convention cases; no scope change
    (h2 : 2 ≤ Fintype.card U) (y : U → ℝ) :
    populationVariance y = 0 ↔ ∀ i j, y i = y j := by
  have hne : Nonempty U := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (Fintype.card U : ℝ) - 1 := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card U : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    linarith
  constructor
  · intro h i j
    rw [populationVariance] at h
    have hS : ∑ k, (y k - populationMean y) ^ 2 = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (inv_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hNpos))
    have hzero := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun k _ => sq_nonneg
      (y k - populationMean y)).mp hS
    have hi : y i = populationMean y :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (hzero i (Finset.mem_univ i)))
    have hj : y j = populationMean y :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (hzero j (Finset.mem_univ j)))
    rw [hi, hj]
  · intro h
    have hmean : ∀ i : U, populationMean y = y i := by
      intro i
      rw [populationMean, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => h j i,
        Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ (card_ne_zero_real U), one_mul]
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset U), (y i - populationMean y) ^ 2 = (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro i _; rw [hmean i]; ring
    rw [populationVariance, Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero]
entries.result: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance y = 0 ↔ ∀ (i j : U), y i = y j
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance_eq_zero_iff
entries.doc: For a population with at least two units, zero variance characterises constancy.

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] (y : U → ℝ), 0 ≤ StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance y
entries.source:
/-- The finite-population variance is nonnegative (including the degenerate `N ≤ 1`
cases, where it is `0` by convention). -/
theorem populationVariance_nonneg (y : U → ℝ) : 0 ≤ populationVariance y := by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty U with hU | hU
  · simp [populationVariance]
  · refine mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr ?_) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card U : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos (α := U)
    linarith
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance_nonneg
entries.doc:
The finite-population variance is nonnegative (including the degenerate `N ≤ 1`
cases, where it is `0` by convention).

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype U] (c : ℝ) (y : U → ℝ), (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance fun i => c * y i) = c ^ 2 * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance y
entries.source:
/-- Quadratic scaling of the finite-population variance. -/
theorem populationVariance_smul (c : ℝ) (y : U → ℝ) :
    populationVariance (fun i => c * y i) = c ^ 2 * populationVariance y := by
  simp only [populationVariance, populationMean_smul]
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset U), (c * y i - c * populationMean y) ^ 2
      = c ^ 2 * (y i - populationMean y) ^ 2 := fun i _ => by ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring
entries.result: (StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance fun i => c * y i) = c ^ 2 * StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance y
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.populationVariance_smul
entries.doc: Quadratic scaling of the finite-population variance.

entries.statement: {B : Type u_1} → [Fintype B] → [DecidableEq B] → {Ω : B → Type u_2} → [(b : B) → Fintype (Ω b)] → [(b : B) → DecidableEq (Ω b)] → ((b : B) → PMF (Ω b)) → PMF ((b : B) → Ω b)

noncomputable def productDesign (D : ∀ b, PMF (Ω b)) : PMF (∀ b, Ω b) :=
  PMF.ofFintype (fun ω => ∏ b, D b (ω b)) (sum_prod_pmf D)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.productDesign

The **product design**: independent randomization across the strata, with mass
`∏ b, D b (ω b)` (`Mead §9.4`, independence of randomisation in different blocks).

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [DecidableEq U] [inst_2 : Fintype T] [DecidableEq T] (r : T → ℕ), ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U → ∀ (t : T), r t ≤ Fintype.card U
entries.source:
/-- Every replication is at most the population size. -/
theorem replication_le_card (r : T → ℕ)
    (hr : ∑ t, r t = Fintype.card U) (t : T) :
    r t ≤ Fintype.card U := by
  rw [← hr]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := r) (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (r i)) (Finset.mem_univ t)
entries.name: StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.replication_le_card
entries.doc: Every replication is at most the population size.

entries.statement: {U : Type u_1} → {T : Type u_2} → [Fintype U] → [DecidableEq T] → (U → ℝ) → StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Allocation U T → ℝ
entries.source:
/-- The **residual (within-groups) sum of squares**: variation of each observation
around its own arm mean (`Mead §6.2`, Table 6.1). -/
noncomputable def residualSS (y : U → ℝ) (g : Allocation U T) : ℝ :=

entries.statement: ∀ {U : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype U] [DecidableEq U] [Fintype T] [inst_3 : DecidableEq T] (y : U → ℝ) (g : StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.Allocation U T), StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.residualSS y g ≤ StatLean.ExperimentalDesign.totalSS y
